name: fiveai-mcp
description: FiveM local debug MCP (FiveAI) - v1 type contracts.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm run build:entry && pnpm run build:broker
scripts.build:entry: esbuild src/cli/entry.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/entry.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:broker: esbuild src/broker/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/broker.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && node --test "tests/**/*.test.ts"
